rationale: The plan matches the reference on every design-driven point: raw counts go straight into DESeq2 Wald (with edgeR QL as a cross-check), no tximport length offset, no TPM/FPKM, a justified 5-in-3 floor with gene counts reported, median-of-ratios/TMM inside the model, explicit control reference level and (condition, treated, control) contrast, BH at 0.05 with apeglm and any lfcThreshold inside results(), and blind-VST PCA/distance/library-size QC with a stated report-not-drop outlier policy. The report step names versions, design, thresholds, tested and significant counts, the n=3 power limit before the gene table, and the library type. The enrichment step was not requested, though it is executed defensibly (full Wald-ranked list, named hallmark/GO BP 2026.1, tested-gene universe, 15-500 window, seed, ORA suppressed below 50 genes); the only blemish is a caveat invoking gene-length bias in enrichment on count data, which sits awkwardly against the plan's own correct point that 3' tag counts carry no length dependence.
